rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Thanks to all of you, my training tour
around Iira looks set to end in great
success, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Until now, Tekuteku thought fresh
ideas and information mattered most in
business, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But watching you made me realize
connections between people matter too,
mo...

rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I learned all that after coming to
this city in Iira, mo! Now I love this
city, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0005
rows.name:
But Tekuteku is a merchant, mo! Soon
I'll leave this city and head to a new
one to broaden my horizons, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Don't worry, mo! No matter where I go,
I won't forget you, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_05_msg0007
rows.name:
Because you're... Tekuteku's best
friends in Iira, mo!
